target_customer: Consumers who curate product catalogs and shoppers who read them; revenue from referral bonuses on products sold
problem: Product recommendations online lacked an editorial, community-curated format where authors earned a share of referral income.
business_model: affiliate referral revenue shared with catalog authors

founders.name: Brendan Doms
founders.background_notes: YC page bio (written later) says he is now CTO at Adni and previously sold a company to UnitedHealthcare. Pre-2006 background not found.

founders.name: Sean McBride
founders.background_notes: YC page lists later employers only (Range, Intercom, Adobe, Typekit, Google), not prior to founding.

exit.reason: The YC page says only that it shut down in 2007; no reason is stated.

competitors.name: ThisNext
competitors.what: Social shopping recommendation service built on user reviews and shopcasts

technical_complexity.rationale: A catalog authoring site with referral tracking was standard web development in 2006.

defensibility.rationale: Copyable by social shopping sites; value would depend on author community which had not formed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented; the company shut down in 2007.

market_need_then: Social shopping sites such as ThisNext were launching in 2006 (source dated 2006-08), indicating investor and user interest in recommendation sites.

branding.domain_note: Used zanbazaar.com (exact name .com); acquisition history not found.

brand_strength.rationale: Branding search found no press or community about the brand, so no evidence of strength.

outcome_analysis: Zanbazaar was a four person Boston team in YC Summer 2006 building community-curated product catalogs that paid authors referral bonuses. Its YC page says it shut down in 2007. No post-mortem or reporting on the cause was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty.
notes: Site fetch returned HTTP 503. Funding search and founder search found no rounds. A third-party directory lists only Brian Shih as founder, conflicting with the YC page listing four. Kaboodle was named in the search snippet as a Feb 2006 launch but its source was not opened, so it is not listed as a dated competitor.
